newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Trade picks up on firmer Bahrain stock exchange.
newsitem.headline: Trade picks up on firmer Bahrain stock exchange.

text.p: Turnover picked up on the Bahrain Stock Exchange in the week to Thursday in trade dominated by banking and tourism sector stocks.
The Bahrain Stock Exchange said the index ended the week higher at 1,339.68 points from a previous 1,333.92 points.
Around 4.2 million shares worth 738,735 dinars ($1.96 million) were traded from last week's 1.3 million shares worth 319,205 dinars ($847,000).
Some 283,200 dinars worth of banking stocks and about 228,300 dinars worth of hotel and tourism stocks were traded.
Shares of 22 firms were traded in 93 transactions.
Bahrain's bourse is open to nationals in Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates. Some firms are also open to foreign investors.
